status: CPU/native/real-WASM regression fixed and independently reviewed; no GPU or browser execution
scope: Only shared stroke expansion unit normalization and internal validated-length helpers, plus native/WASM regressions and documentation. Camera, document schema, GPU backends, export multipliers and scene transform admission unchanged. No commit, push or deployment by this task.

contract.activation: stroke::expand receives local tolerance <1e-6; ordinary tolerance path avoids new normalization
contract.unit_change: one translation to the first point and one power-of-two scale for each complete contour. Normalized tolerance approximately 1/64–1/32. No independent per-segment scaling.
preserved: per-contour dash restart and closed-seam handling
contract.budget: 131072 subdivisions per arc, 2000000 total output points, 100000 profile input points. Uniform and synthesized-profile dash count stays global20000; authored widthProfile retains original per-contour dash count.
contract.finite_range: Normalization checks power-of-two exponent<=1023, finite scaled values with <=1e100 arithmetic headroom, finite dash sum and mapped-back points. Invalid normalization errors explicitly, not empty/NaN geometry.
contract.internal_limits: Original values validate before changing units; normalized width/dash values are not reinterpreted as authored values, so no false rejection at document-unit limits.
